description: Create a new hosting account plan named 'Business Pro' in Virtualmin with the following limits: Server disk quota: 10 GB, Administration total quota: 20 GB, Bandwidth limit: 100 GB, Max databases: 10, Max mail/FTP users: 100, Max mail aliases: 200, Max non-alias sub-servers: 10, Max alias servers: 5. Enable features: Web, SSL, DNS, Mail, MySQL, Webmin login, Log rotation. After creating the plan, apply it to the existing virtual server 'acmecorp.test'.
